title: Verify scalar kernel encoding and the actual R429 native boundary
body:
## Summary

Test a fixed 102-to-111 scalar kerR encoding against the actual R429 bulk and native boundaries. All 633 independent binary columns pass, including 429 arbitrary helpers and return of 18 parity cells to zero. The literal encoder costs 470 ADDs per bank and 1,880 for both banks forward/reverse.

The complete optimistic ordinary paired caller fails: for every odd L>=3, its deficit is D=-24L-102<0, so every positive contracting-child exponent fails. Actual native source entrances and target MOVE cuts separately rule out treating this scalar code or its stipulated virtual-target reconstruction as free.

## Scope and limits

One package, `research/r429-kernel-encoding-boundary`. The selected basis minimizes MOVE event count (44), not encoder ADD count. The invoice includes every public idle and fractional width-eight helper bank/padding, while granting encoder/decoder and cleanup costs free. A changed topology requires another complete invoice.

The source obstruction is a complete F1009 witness against every nonzero scalar column, hence against a uniformly valid scalar encoder. The target obstruction covers all 470 required coefficients at actual last-MOVE cuts; 537 exact Gram certificates establish the necessary nonzero maps in every odd characteristic. The independent review binds the historical nine completed-cap matrices to their actual cuts and adds explicit old/new update witnesses.

Target reconstruction is limited to same-frame VALUE ADDs and native-zero head/tail-separate ADDRESS adapters on surviving public targets. The retained-old case keeps the previous virtual target unchanged and adds a correction from those public targets; arbitrary processing or mixing of retained virtual buffers is outside it. Integer-zero cleanup, operator-valued encoders, changed target-reading words, query sharing, physical owners, rounding and source/tape implementation remain open. No positive supplier, unrestricted encoding barrier, selected-frontier change or new κ is claimed.

## Test plan

- [x] Complete registered Python 3.12.14 replay of the producer, independent native checker, independent accounting checker and integrity controls; scientific commit `9966b363c7eb2032fd7e83fe200eb3a9839a424b`, with only final review/validation prose added for publication.
- [x] All 651-by-633 binary entries, 18 parity-zero returns, literal inverse, 111 actual charts/source images, 102 source witnesses and 470 target-cut coefficients.
- [x] 537 Gram bases, nine actual rho/update witnesses, every historical completed-cap witness and exact specialization premises.
- [x] Independent reverse reader adjoints, 512-element binary spans, complete encoder, optimal MOVE-count certificate, every saved invoice coefficient and written all-L deficit proof.
- [x] Real parity-ADD, target-reading, equal-frame/no-change, native-entrance and accounting mutations; 18-path omission exposes a false favorable deficit.
- [x] All 13 retained inputs authenticated, all three complete receipts compared with types, explicit path/output adapters, corruption/coverage/path-collision/poisoned-source-cache controls in normal/-O and committed export.
- [x] Separate AI mathematical and integrity reviews; metadata and source-history preflight. No independent human or formal-kernel certification.
- [x] Automatic exact-head GitHub CI [39247316873](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/39247316873) passed at `580c911c9d79164df5ec7d3e4ed8a2a0c75bbc26`; full package replay and unchanged-input gate passed. No manual rerun requested.

## Sources and credit

Scientific pin: `20ecf2891d80b5acf18d980b2164fb44ea7faa90`. Retain Sagar Thakrar's R438 transport, the eumemic/DreamingOfClouds/Ali Romman lineage, and the exact R429 source-code word published in [PR3645](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3645). Its helper deletions, source code and cap audit are prior work.

Ali Romman [PR1136](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1136) already supplies related binary-encoding/native-boundary results for a different centered shear. James Reed [PR3850](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3850), based on Gonzalo-Mier PR3772, supplies related paired-schedule accounting. [PR4033](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/4033) and [PR4039](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/4039) use different full-input interfaces. This restricted-input code does not contradict those contracts. The bounded overlap search is not a novelty certificate.

Prepared by Ross Richardson with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance and separate AI reviews. Apache-2.0; original notices, exact bytes and provenance retained.
